_comment: Default ProgramBench arm. Copy to programbench.json and run: uv run python -m runs.run_bench programbench <instance-id> --profile runs/profiles/programbench.json. Provider creds stay in .env (do NOT put OPENAI_AUTH_TOKEN in a committed profile). Network isolation stays on by default — see --no-network-isolation only if you must.

env._comment: Catalogued knobs forwarded into the container (see docs/configuration.md). Applied fill-the-gaps: a real export still wins.

run._comment: programbench long options (run_bench.py programbench; without --). Defaults; an explicit CLI flag overrides.
